mapper.select:
SELECT v.*, s.name as student_name, s.student_no, CONCAT(b.name, ' - ', r.room_number) as room_info FROM tb_visitor v LEFT JOIN tb_student s ON v.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN tb_building b ON s.building_id = b.building_id LEFT JOIN tb_room r ON s.room_id = r.room_id
AND v.visitor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND v.status = #{status}
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_visitor (student_id, visitor_name, phone, id_card, reason, visit_start_time, status, create_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{visitorName}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{reason}, #{visitStartTime}, 0, NOW())
